question: T15, predicted before the read of CAP-T15FIELDENDS (Blocks Probe): on a new Shape's Design tab, (a) a value typed past its bar's end, then dragged by the field's top strip, 20 px in steps of 20: Rotate 400 degrees dragged up and (typed again) down, Scale 900% down, Offset 5000px up; (b) Opacity 50% taken, then 33 typed in Skew and not taken (no Enter), then Cmd+Z, and Cmd+Z again. Two runs, each on a new Shape.
rule: Ours as built (inferred, 'a value typed past an end is not pulled back by a drag, nor taken further'): the drag moves only toward the bar, 0.4 per px: Rotate 400 +20 stays 400, -20 gives 392; Scale 900 -20 gives 892%; Offset 5000 +20 stays 5,000px. Cmd+Z with Design's typing not taken is left to the field: the typed 33 goes back to 0 in Skew, and no page step is undone, so Opacity stays 50% after both. Rival P: the drag first pulls the value to the bar's end, then moves: 360, 352, 192%, 1,000px. Rival A (as read on Animation's fields, CAP-T15FIELDS2.json): Cmd+Z is the page's undo, the typing goes and the last change is undone, Opacity 50% back to 100%, the field keeping the focus; the second Cmd+Z undoes the step before (Offset 5000 back).
from: Ours read in the code (app/src/editor.js, the Design branch of the field drag: min(max(hi, start), max(min(lo, start), start + dx * 0.4)); Design's inputs have no Cmd+Z handler of their own), not replayed.
hit: The field's value after each drag (dragRow's after), and Opacity and Skew after each Cmd+Z (rowValues). Each case names the empty read taken right after its drag or values, '<label> done'.
